lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: predicting the effect of a rigid motion on a figure
lessonRef.title: Reteach and varied practice: predicting the effect of a rigid motion on a figure

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: These two examples show the same idea in two different formats.

items.prompt: What does it mean for two figures to be congruent?

steps: One can be moved onto the other.
The motion must preserve distance and angle.
workedSolution.answer: a sequence of rigid motions maps one onto the other

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and the pair of included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.
Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 50° and ∠B = 32°. Find ∠F.
If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
choices: every pair of corresponding sides and angles is congruent
only the corresponding sides are congruent
the triangles have equal area but need not be congruent
only the corresponding angles are congruent

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and a pair of non-included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: they can be scaled to match
there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 33° and ∠B = 39°. Find ∠F.
A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: preserves area but may change side lengths
maps every figure to a similar figure
preserves shape but may change size

items.prompt: In two triangles, all three pairs of corresponding sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
